pieces.Text: At 6th level, a wild stalker can either take a rage power, or gains a +2 insight bonus into any one of the following skills - Acrobatics, Climb, Perception, Stealth, Survival, or Swim. The wild stalker can gain one of these two benefits again every five levels after 6th (to a maximum of 4 times at 20th level). This ability replaces the ranger's 6nd-, 10th-, 14th, and 18th-level combat style feats.
